defuss-brotli: third-party notices
==============================================================================

dist/compressor.wasm and dist/decompressor.wasm, also embedded as base64 in
dist/compressor.js and dist/decompressor.js, contain code compiled from the
components below; the JavaScript glue in dist/*.js is generated by
wasm-bindgen. Crates that run only at build time (procedural macros:
wasm-bindgen-macro, wasm-bindgen-macro-support, syn, quote, proc-macro2,
unicode-ident, bumpalo) are not part of the shipped files.

Component                         License                         Used in
--------------------------------  ------------------------------  ------------
brotli 8.0.2                      BSD-3-Clause AND MIT            compressor
brotli-decompressor 5.0.0         BSD-3-Clause OR MIT             both
alloc-no-stdlib 2.0.4             BSD-3-Clause                    both
alloc-stdlib 0.2.2                BSD-3-Clause                    compressor
wasm-bindgen 0.2.114              MIT OR Apache-2.0               both
wasm-bindgen-shared 0.2.114       MIT OR Apache-2.0               both
once_cell 1.21.3                  MIT OR Apache-2.0               both
cfg-if 1.0.4                      MIT OR Apache-2.0               both
Rust standard library (rustc      Apache-2.0 OR MIT, with the     both
1.99.1): core, alloc; std in      exceptions listed in its
the compressor                    COPYRIGHT-library notice

Where a component offers a choice of licenses, it is used under BSD-3-Clause
(brotli-decompressor) or MIT (all others).
